summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Indra’s cleansing from Brahmanicide after slaying Vritra and begins the myth explaining the origin of Fever during Daksha’s sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the jeweled summit of Mount Meru, Shiva sits beside Parvati while gods, sages, spirits, and Nandi gather around in a radiant celestial court.
The sin of Brahmanicide leaves Indra and departs to the places assigned by Brahma as the king of gods prepares a horse sacrifice for purification.
From the slain body of the demon Vritra, streams of blood give rise to high-crested cocks spreading across the earth.
